title: The structure-activity relationship study of torkinib derivatives as mTOR inhibitors with senolytic and STAT3 inhibitory activities.
authors: Oleksak, Patrik; Rysanek, David; Vancurova, Marketa; Novak, Josef; Maurencova, Dominika; Rousarova, Erika; Capek, Jan; Rousar, Tomas; Vales, Karel; Skopek, Vojtech; Maslowska, Martyna Julia; Gumauskaite, Kotryna; Stankus, Gabrielius; Kuca, Kamil; Andrys, Rudolf; Skarka, Adam; Lisa, Miroslav; Fresser, Lukas; Surovcova, Sabina; Chrienova, Zofia; Popr, Martin; Nepovimova, Eugenie; Hodny, Zdenek
one_liner_zh: 该研究为mTOR抑制剂衍生物的合成与构效关系分析，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题无关。
abstract: The mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR) sits at the center of several cellular pathways determining cell growth, function, and stress adaptation. Dysregulated mTOR signaling contributes to aging-related diseases and cancer, making mTOR inhibitors an important class of anticancer therapeutics. Likewise, STAT3 is a transcription factor that drives cell proliferation and survival, and its hyperactivation is implicated in many cancers. As a result, STAT3 inhibitors also represent a promising group of anticancer compounds. This study describes the synthesis and characterization of 10 heteroarene derivatives of torkinib, a known mTOR inhibitor. We evaluated these compounds for their mTOR and STAT3 inhibitory activities, growth inhibitory and senolytic effects. A structure-activity relationship (SAR) study and molecular docking analysis were conducted to elucidate key structural features. Notably, torkinib derivative 4k demonstrated potent mTOR inhibition without affecting STAT3 phosphorylation, whereas its analog 4j inhibited phosphorylation of both mTOR and STAT3. Furthermore, compared to compound 4j, compound 4k exhibited cytotoxicity against both proliferating and senescent cells, comparable to torkinib despite its weaker TORC1 inhibition. In conclusion, our findings reveal structural alignments crucial for enhanced mTOR and STAT3 inhibition.
abstract_zh: 雷帕霉素的机制靶点（mTOR）位于决定细胞生长、功能和应激适应的多个细胞通路中心。mTOR信号传导失调与衰老相关疾病和癌症有关，使mTOR抑制剂成为一类重要的抗癌治疗药物。同样，STAT3是一种驱动细胞增殖和存活的转录因子，其过度激活与多种癌症相关。因此，STAT3抑制剂也代表了一类有前景的抗癌化合物。本研究描述了10种torkinib（一种已知的mTOR抑制剂）的杂芳烃衍生物的合成与表征。我们评估了这些化合物对mTOR和STAT3的抑制活性、生长抑制及促衰老细胞死亡（senolytic）效应。通过构效关系（SAR）研究和分子对接分析，阐明了关键结构特征。值得注意的是，torkinib衍生物4k表现出强效的mTOR抑制而不影响STAT3磷酸化，而其类似物4j则抑制mTOR和STAT3两者的磷酸化。此外，与化合物4j相比，化合物4k对增殖细胞和衰老细胞均表现出细胞毒性，尽管其TORC1抑制较弱，但效果与torkinib相当。总之，我们的发现揭示了增强mTOR和STAT3抑制所必需的结构排列。
